snippet.title: The Dungeon Experience Mudcrab Interview - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
A talking mudcrab from The Dungeon Experience interrupted our hosts to reveal more about this wonderfully-irreverent adventure game from Devolver Digital. It's coming soon to PC.
https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/994680/The_Dungeon_Experience/

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
